summary: BUDDIZ Phase 1 tested end-to-end. Backend: 23/23 pytest cases passed covering auth (register/login/me + 401s), meals discovery with search + all filters (categories/interests/small_groups/available_now), address-privacy (hidden for anon/guest, visible for host), remaining_guests math (Marie pates = 2), config, profile update, upload+file fetch, and /meals/mine auth guard. Frontend (mobile 390x844): welcome shows 3 auth buttons, email login as marie@buddiz.demo lands on Découvrir with 6 meal cards, session PERSISTS after refresh, search 'pizza' filters to 1 card, meal detail shows address-hidden privacy block and send-message button (no exact address leaked), bottom nav Recherche/Ajouter/Messages/Profil all reachable, Messages empty state OK, Add hosting intro OK, Profile shows user + stats + Modifier/Déconnexion, edit-profile save works, logout returns to Welcome, and registering a new account lands logged-in on Discover. No React Native red screens, no deprecated packages (uses expo-image-picker etc, no expo-av/barcode-scanner/background-fetch).

ui_bugs.issue: In the filters modal, clicking data-testid='category-chip-Halal' via Playwright didn't visibly apply the filter (returned all 6 meals). Chip likely requires scroll-into-view first; not a functional bug from a real user perspective but worth confirming category-chip press feedback and that ScrollView reveals all chips on small screens.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'Animated: useNativeDriver is not supported ... Falling back to JS-based animation.' Expected on web preview; harmless on native. No action needed unless targeting animations perf audit.

Console warning: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' Likely from one of the card/button style objects. Non-blocking but should be migrated to boxShadow for RN 0.76+ compatibility. Reference: components using shadowColor/shadowOffset/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius.
Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents.' Move pointerEvents into style prop wherever it is passed as a plain prop.

action_items: LOW: Duplicate testID 'go-register-link' is present on both welcome.tsx and login.tsx. Playwright strict-mode locators resolve to 2 elements. Consider renaming one (e.g. welcome-register-link vs login-register-link) so automated tests can uniquely target each.
LOW: Migrate shadow* style props to boxShadow (React Native 0.76+) to silence deprecation warnings.
LOW: Move any component-level pointerEvents prop into style.pointerEvents.

OPTIONAL: In filters modal, ensure category/interest chip rows are horizontally scrollable and fully reachable on 390px width; confirm chip press provides visible selected-state feedback (color change) so users see selection before tapping Appliquer.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 878 lines - approaching the 700-line soft limit; consider splitting into modules (auth, meals, uploads, seed) before Phase 2.

GET /api/files/{path} accepts token query/authorization header but never validates ownership; comment says 'reads are non-sensitive'. Fine for public meal/profile photos but do not use this endpoint for private uploads later.
meal_public performs N+1 queries (users + seats_taken bookings loop) per meal in list_meals; acceptable for 6 seeds, but batch/aggregate for scale.
All Mongo reads correctly project out '_id'. Good.
All frontend API calls use process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL via api client. Good.
seed_data_creation: None; used existing seeded users (marie/david/sophie) and 6 seeded meals. Registered a few TEST_ prefixed users during testing (test_prof_*, test_ui_*).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 1 fully green. If Phase 2 adds bookings/messaging: reuse /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py as regression base, add booking state transitions (REQUESTED -> ACCEPTED_PENDING_PAYMENT -> CONFIRMED) and confirm address_visible flips to true for confirmed guest. UI testIDs to know: search-input, open-filters-button, category-chip-{name}, apply-filters-button, meal-card-{id}, address-hidden-box, send-message-button, edit-profile-button, save-profile-button, logout-button, auth-email-button, go-register-link (DUPLICATE - use .first).
rca_of_issue: No blocking issues found. Two transient artifacts during the run: (1) a Cloudflare 502 Bad Gateway during a page reload — infra hiccup, retried and session persistence confirmed OK. (2) Playwright strict-mode error on 'go-register-link' because that testID is present on both Welcome and Login screens simultaneously in the DOM; fixed the test by using locator.first, but the app code should give each occurrence a unique testID.
